profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Electronic Arts (EA)
profile.summary: I've been both programming and playing video games for as long as I can remember. I wanted to be a programmer professionally for almost as long. At some point in my life, it occurred to me that a person could probably make a living programming video games. So, I got degrees in computer science and video game engineering.Currently, I make a living programming tools to help other developers, and I write video games in my spare time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer at EADP Data team providing data that are useful to business users and game teams. Mainly responsible as a developer for analytics platform

- Develop ETL job which processes raw data (XML, gz files) into a structured format for analysis purpose
- Analyze, design, and develop new features to the analytics platform, spanning from backend to the front end UI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Optimized game cutscenes, items, and environments for mobile puzzle platform experience with Unity profiler to keep frame rate above 60.
Created engaging mini games using C# and Unity, which led to development of game’s hyper-casual audience.
Architected and wrote enemy AI logic using A* pathfinding algorithm in C# and Unity.
Designed and implemented UI components using C# and Unity to provide engaging feedback for users.
Led development meetings with other departments to boost communication and reduce development issues.
Implemented agile scrum methodology utilizing Jira and Trello, improving performance and efficiency of engineering team by 2X on average.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• ESE588 Quantitative Image Processing; JEE2300 Introduction to Electrical Networks
• Held TA hours twice a week, answered all the course questions, graded all homework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• 6 out of 500 selected
• Group leader in charge of algorithm development for feasibility analysis of Cardiac CT
• Reconstructed CT image from raw data collected in 3 hospitals, using MATLAB under UNIX system
• Successfully developed an application to find the best diagnostic phase in the given series of CT images

educations.schoolName: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked as a team leader for the student volunteers. Acted as a liaison between the student volunteers and the venue chairs. Coordinated student volunteers during their shifts.
